notes.title: Quick patch to fix day one bugs
notes.notes:
There were two bugs that I was able to identify in a stream by https://www.twitch.tv/catboiaoi (Who I haven't talked to directly yet but I thought he would be worth crediting)

First, The queue was always pulling in 7 people at a time no matter the queue size.
Second, if the Dealer hits a raw 21, the skip ui stops working until the dealer's next turn.

These both SHOULD be fixed now. Honestly I'm not sure how I didn't run into them sooner.

I'll admit I was not able to get that many testers with larger audiences on board to try something like this, so there's potential to be some quirks that'll pop up, but I think that's all the major issues.
